ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon / FamousSparrow SparrowDoor sideload via signed AV-vendor binary run from writable directory
ucs.description: Hunts the SparrowDoor / Crowdoor / Demodex delivery chain Earth Estries (Salt Typhoon / FamousSparrow / GhostEmperor) reliably reuses: drop a legitimately-signed AV-vendor utility (K7Sysmon.exe, Indexer.exe, ESET / McAfee / Bitdefender helpers) into ProgramData / Public / AppData together with a same-name malicious DLL, then launch it so the trusted binary side-loads the implant. The dual constraint of signed-by-AV + non-Program-Files install path is highly specific to this cluster.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*"))
          (Processes.process_name IN ("k7sysmon.exe","indexer.exe","esetservice.exe","esets_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","bdservicehost.exe","vftrace.exe","ehstorauthn.exe"))
          Processes.process_path!="*\\Program Files*"
          Processes.parent_process_name!="msiexec.exe"
          Processes.parent_process_name!="setup.exe"
    by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WritablePaths = dynamic([@'\programdata\', @'\users\public\', @'\appdata\roaming\', @'\appdata\local\temp\']);
let SignedVendors = dynamic(['K7 Computing','ESET','McAfee','Bitdefender','Trend Micro','Symantec','Kaspersky']);
let SideloaderBins = dynamic(['k7sysmon.exe','indexer.exe','esetservice.exe','esets_proxy.exe','mcoemcpy.exe','bdservicehost.exe','vftrace.exe','ehstorauthn.exe']);
let Procs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where tolower(FolderPath) has_any (WritablePaths)
    | where FileName in~ (SideloaderBins) or ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any (SignedVendors)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ('msiexec.exe','setup.exe','installer.exe','tiworker.exe')
    | where AccountName !endswith '$'
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId, FileName,
              FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, Vendor = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName;
let Loads = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) has_any (WritablePaths)
    | where tolower(FileName) endswith '.dll'
    | where not (FolderPath has_any (@'\windows\system32\', @'\windows\syswow64\', @'\program files\'))
    | where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has_any (SignedVendors)
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, LoadedDll = FileName, LoadedDllPath = FolderPath, InitiatingProcessId;
Procs
| join kind=inner Loads on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where LoadTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SignedBinary = FileName, BinaryPath = FolderPath, Vendor,
          LoadedDll, LoadedDllPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WritablePaths = dynamic([@'\programdata\', @'\users\public\', @'\appdata\roaming\', @'\appdata\local\temp\']);
let SignedVendors = dynamic(['K7 Computing','ESET','McAfee','Bitdefender','Trend Micro','Symantec','Kaspersky']);
let SideloaderBins = dynamic([@'\k7sysmon.exe', @'\indexer.exe', @'\esetservice.exe', @'\esets_proxy.exe', @'\mcoemcpy.exe', @'\bdservicehost.exe', @'\vftrace.exe', @'\ehstorauthn.exe']);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where tolower(TargetProcessName) has_any (WritablePaths)
| where tolower(TargetProcessName) has_any (SideloaderBins)
   or TargetProcessFileCompany has_any (SignedVendors)
   or ActingProcessFileCompany has_any (SignedVendors)
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @'\msiexec.exe'
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @'\setup.exe'
| where ActorUsername !endswith '$'
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          SignedBinary = TargetProcessName,
          BinaryVendor = coalesce(TargetProcessFileCompany, ActingProcessFileCompany),
          ParentName = ParentProcessName, ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine,
          ChildCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon SparrowDoor DLL sideload via signed AV-vendor binary
id: 8c3e2a9f-1b4d-4e5a-9c7b-2f1d3e4a5b6c
status: experimental
description: Detects a signed AV-vendor utility (K7Sysmon, ESET, McAfee, Bitdefender helpers, Indexer.exe) running from a non-canonical writable directory — Salt Typhoon / FamousSparrow / Earth Estries reliably stage SparrowDoor, Crowdoor and Demodex loaders this way.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2021/09/23/famoussparrow-suspicious-hotel-guest/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/23/h/earth-estries-targets-government-tech-for-cyberespionage.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1218
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g1045
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  selection_binary:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\K7Sysmon.exe'
      - '\Indexer.exe'
      - '\ESETService.exe'
      - '\esets_proxy.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\bdservicehost.exe'
      - '\VFTrace.exe'
      - '\EhStorAuthn.exe'
  filter_install:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
  filter_program_files:
    Image|contains: '\Program Files'
  condition: selection_path and selection_binary and not (filter_install or filter_program_files)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate AV installer staging files in ProgramData prior to service registration
  - Portable AV scanners deliberately executed from removable media
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\* OR *\AppData\Roaming\* OR *\appdata\roaming\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\appdata\local\temp\*) @Image:(*\K7Sysmon.exe OR *\k7sysmon.exe OR *\Indexer.exe OR *\indexer.exe OR *\ESETService.exe OR *\esetservice.exe OR *\esets_proxy.exe OR *\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\McOemCpy.exe OR *\bdservicehost.exe OR *\BdServiceHost.exe OR *\VFTrace.exe OR *\vftrace.exe OR *\EhStorAuthn.exe) -@ParentImage:(*\msiexec.exe OR *\MsiExec.exe OR *\setup.exe OR *\TiWorker.exe) -@Image:(*\Program\ Files\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(ProgramData|Users\\Public|AppData\\Roaming|AppData\\Local\\Temp)\\/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(K7Sysmon|Indexer|ESETService|esets_proxy|mcoemcpy|bdservicehost|VFTrace|EhStorAuthn)\.exe$/i
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^(msiexec|setup|TiWorker)\.exe$/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=([count(as=hits), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])]))
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The combination of (1) a *signed* binary by a security-vendor company, (2) executing from a writable user-area path rather than Program Files, and (3) a same-process DLL load from that same path is the documented Salt Typhoon / FamousSparrow / Earth Estries delivery pattern for SparrowDoor, Crowdoor and the Demodex/GhostEmperor loader. ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries WMIC /node fan-out paired with LSASS / NTDS credential extraction on the same staging host
ucs.description: Earth Estries' post-compromise playbook on telecom and government environments is a WMIC `/node:` lateral-movement burst from a single staging host across multiple internal targets, performed within the same window as on-box credential dumping via comsvcs.dll MiniDump, ProcDump on lsass, or ntdsutil 'ifm create' on a domain controller. The temporal join between fan-out WMIC and credential dumping on the same device is the high-fidelity Salt Typhoon signal — neither half alone is unique.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as wmic_cmds min(_time) as firstWmic max(_time) as lastWmic
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*/node:*"
    by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=30m
| rex field=wmic_cmds max_match=0 "(?i)/node:\s*\"?(?<remote_node>[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"
| stats values(remote_node) as nodes dc(remote_node) as node_count values(wmic_cmds) as wmic_sample min(firstWmic) as firstWmic max(lastWmic) as lastWmic by dest user
| where node_count >= 5
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=true values(Processes.process) as dump_cmd min(_time) as dumpTime
        from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
        where ((Processes.process_name="procdump.exe" Processes.process="*lsass*")
            OR (Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" Processes.process="*MiniDump*" Processes.process="*lsass*")
            OR (Processes.process="*rundll32*" Processes.process="*comsvcs*" Processes.process="*MiniDump*")
            OR (Processes.process="*ntdsutil*" Processes.process="*ifm*")
            OR (Processes.process="*ntdsutil*" Processes.process="*\"create full*"))
        by Processes.dest _time
    | stats values(dump_cmd) as dump_cmd min(_time) as dumpTime by dest
  ]
| where dumpTime >= (firstWmic - 3600) AND dumpTime <= (lastWmic + 3600)
| eval delta_sec = dumpTime - firstWmic
| `security_content_ctime(firstWmic)`
| `security_content_ctime(dumpTime)`
| table firstWmic dumpTime delta_sec dest user node_count nodes wmic_sample dump_cmd
| sort - firstWmic
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let DumpEvents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ 'procdump.exe' and ProcessCommandLine has 'lsass')
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ('comsvcs.dll','MiniDump') and ProcessCommandLine has 'lsass')
         or (FileName =~ 'rundll32.exe' and ProcessCommandLine has 'comsvcs' and ProcessCommandLine has 'MiniDump')
         or (FileName =~ 'ntdsutil.exe' and ProcessCommandLine has_any ('ifm','snapshot','create full'))
    | where AccountName !endswith '$'
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, DumpAccount = AccountName,
              DumpProc = FileName, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName =~ 'wmic.exe'
| where ProcessCommandLine has '/node:'
| where AccountName !endswith '$'
| extend RemoteNode = extract(@'(?i)/node:\s*["]?([A-Za-z0-9\.\-\_]+)', 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| where isnotempty(RemoteNode)
| summarize NodeCount = dcount(RemoteNode),
            Nodes = make_set(RemoteNode, 25),
            FirstWmic = min(Timestamp),
            LastWmic = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket = bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where NodeCount >= 5
| join kind=inner DumpEvents on DeviceId
| where DumpTime between (FirstWmic - 1h .. LastWmic + 1h)
| extend DeltaSec = datetime_diff('second', DumpTime, FirstWmic)
| project FirstWmic, DumpTime, DeltaSec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          NodeCount, Nodes, SampleCmd, DumpProc, DumpCmd
| order by FirstWmic desc
